name: Crossword Clue Tutor
briefDescription: Free pattern-aware crossword helper with spoiler-light hints, reviewed definitions, and explanations of why each answer fits.
comments: Crossword Clue Tutor is independently maintained and does not reproduce complete publisher grids or answer keys. Its clue dictionary includes a documented, downloadable dataset of ambiguous clues organized by length and meaning: https://crosswordcluetutor.com/research/ambiguous-crossword-clues/
